decisions.reason: The row insertion and field-copying workflow does not change which Board Meeting fields must align or the identification of Topic as tema.
Copying fields within an inserted Board Meeting row is distinct from migrating content from legacy templates into new templates.
The specified row workflow does not alter the requirements for text wrapping or keeping columns within page margins.
The source defines how users populate a newly inserted Board Meeting row but does not modify table paste stability or column-boundary constraints.
The Board Meeting row workflow does not affect fixed margins in the Vejledning short-description area.
The instruction to copy fields before entering row content does not change manual line-break behavior after legacy-content pasting.
The source establishes a row preparation sequence and does not change ordinary Enter-based multiline input behavior.
The Board Meeting row insertion workflow does not modify the date selector, its format, or its applicable contexts.
Requiring users to copy fields before writing does not rescind or modify the independently established clear-on-activation behavior.
The row insertion and field-copying process is unrelated to list-level transitions, hierarchy structure, or Tab-key behavior.
The instruction to copy fields does not change their required help-label text, hover behavior, locations, or coverage.
The Board Meeting row workflow does not affect bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, spacing, or level variants.
